newsitem.title: UK: Amec details buy from Schneider.
newsitem.headline: Amec details buy from Schneider.

text.p: British construction and engineering group Amec Plc said on Friday it had sealed an outline agreement for the terms of its acquisition of a stake in French building firm Spie Batignolles, a unit of diversified engineering group Schneider SA.

Amec said in a statement the deal, struck in partnership with the management and employees of Spie, would mean it invested 40 million pounds ($66.86 million) in cash. The final level of the investment would depend on the employees' subscriptions but should leave Amec with between 40 and 48.6 percent of the firm.

Within the same deal, Spie will also acquire from Schneider an outstanding 50 percent interest in electrical service unit Spie Trindel, so that it becomes a wholly-owned constituent of the new Spie grouping.

Amec said in its statement that the investment provided it with financial exposure to the new company "limited to its initial investment". It also has an option to acquire the remainder of the shares it does not own in six years' time.
Chief executive Peter Mason said the deal was Amec's first step towards a stated aim of building an international presence "with differentiated technical skills and market strength."
Amec also used the statement as an opportunity to note that trading in the current year continued to be in line with its expectations.
